subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Compor, em língua inglesa, narrativas orais sobre fatos, acontecimentos e personalidades marcantes do passado.

components.description_pt: Compor uma narrativa oral em inglês sobre um evento histórico significativo
components.description_en: Compose an oral narrative in English about a significant historical event
components.cc_component_description: Narrate a historical event, scientific procedure, or technical process in a structured explanatory text

components.description_pt: Compor uma narrativa oral em inglês descrevendo uma figura histórica notável do passado
components.description_en: Compose an oral narrative in English describing a notable historical figure from the past
components.cc_component_description: Organize an oral description so that ideas are communicated in a logical order

components.description_pt: Usar estruturas de tempo passado apropriadamente em narrativa oral em inglês sobre ocorrências históricas
components.description_en: Use past tense structures appropriately in an English oral narrative about historical occurrences
components.cc_component_description: Form the simple past tense of regular and irregular verbs correctly

components.description_pt: Organizar narrativas orais em inglês com sequência coerente de eventos históricos
components.description_en: Organize oral narratives in English with a coherent sequence of historical events
components.cc_component_description: Organize a narrative with a logical and clear sequence of events

cc_matches.description: Describe people, places, things, and events with relevant details, expressing ideas and feelings clearly.
Write informative/explanatory texts, including the narration of historical events, scientific procedures/experiments, or technical processes.
Form and use the simple (e.g., I walked; I walk; I will walk) verb tenses.
Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.
